title: Returns Policy
content: Electronics can be returned within 14 days if unused and with original packaging. Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 business days after inspection.

title: Shipping Policy
content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders above $50 qualify for free standard shipping.

title: Warranty Policy
content: Most electronics include a 12 month limited warranty covering manufacturing defects only.

title: Account Support Policy
content: Customers can reset passwords through the account page. Refund decisions beyond standard policy require admin review.
